flow: TipOne followed by Opentrons commercial tip-rack choice with explicit placement acceptance
Save/Open retains recipe, plate and selected tip geometry

failure_and_correction.diagnosis: The literal source length below the rim 40 mm was not recognized as an axial measurement.
failure_and_correction.correction: Recognize explicitly labelled length/height/distance below, under or beneath the rim/flange while retaining literal numeric units, role binding and ambiguity rejection.
failure_and_correction.causal_limit: The initial raw model response was not recorded, so the exact initial invalid field cannot be established.
failure_and_correction.diagnostic_replay: One later real response to the original unchanged prompt cited length below the rim 40 mm. Offline replay rejects that response with the prior validator and accepts it with the corrected validator.
failure_and_correction.validation_limit: Successful repetition after correction is regression evidence, not an independent generalization benchmark.

gates: Tip identity, geometry and explicitly accepted pose
Late automatic estimate scope and current download reconciliation
validation.document_render: Saved HTML inspected in isolated Chromium desktop 1440×1000 and mobile 390×844; readable 16px prose, no horizontal document overflow; wide tables scroll. Not exhaustive visual QA or real-device gesture testing.

captured_pricing.scope: Observed supplier values plus separately labelled model allowances; not complete machine cost, compatibility or a complete BOM. Unknown supplier line totals remain null.
captured_pricing.supplier_limits: Three supplier candidate-kit requests returned HTTP 429; remaining unpriced scope retained.

reopen_handoff.scope: A reopened runtime regenerates its estimate without a fresh supplier report. Its model-only range is distinct from the captured supplier-reconciled report.

consumption.unresolved_scope: A final post-open automatic estimate was cancelled or in flight at browser close. Its provider consumption is unknown; observed total is not a complete billing total.
consumption.retries: No automatic chat retries; one coordinated instrumented diagnostic after a scoped correction.
